tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Search AI products, models, agents and organizations by keyword. Returns ranked matches with scores and why they matched.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Get the full record for one entity by slug: scores (4 explainable dimensions), evidence, sources, tags, links.

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: List entities, optionally filtered by continent / type, ranked by score_mode.

tools.name: get_entity_relations
tools.description: Get an entity's relations (alternatives, built-on, integrations…) with confidence and target names.

tools.name: compare_entities
tools.description: Compare 2–5 entities across the four scoring dimensions.

tools.name: list_tracks
tools.description: List the 12 AI continents (tracks) with node counts and top nodes.

tools.name: get_taxonomy
tools.description: Get the full continent + region taxonomy.

tools.name: get_snapshot_meta
tools.description: Get the current published snapshot metadata: version, counts, freshness, validation.
